title: The Summer Fresh Board
seo_title: Vegan Summer Board for 6–8: Shopping List & Plan
description: A vegan summer board for 6–8: whipped avocado dip, dairy-free tzatziki, herbed white bean dip, watermelon, cucumber ribbons, snap peas, peaches and tomatoes.
hook: A cool, crunchy board for hot days: three fresh dips, ice-cold watermelon, cucumber ribbons, snap peas and ripe peaches.
why: Summer produce is at its best raw and cold, so this board barely needs cooking. Watermelon with mint and a pinch of flaky salt is the star, and snap peas, radishes and cucumber give crunch for the dips.
The three dips are all cool and bright: lemony avocado, garlicky tzatziki and a herby white bean dip. Basil oil and chili flakes over the tomatoes and peaches add a little heat and colour.

timeline.what: Make the avocado dip with plenty of lemon; chill the watermelon.
Ribbon the cucumber with a peeler; halve the radishes and tomatoes.
Fill the dip bowls; drizzle the white bean dip with basil oil.
Slice the peach; add the snap peas and crackers.
Add the cold watermelon, mint, salt and chili flakes; serve.

faq.a: Yes, every item is plant-based. Check the labels on crackers, breads and store-bought dips, which sometimes contain butter, milk, honey or egg.

faq.q: How long can it sit outside?
faq.a: No more than 2 hours, or 1 hour above 90°F. Keep the watermelon and dips cold until the last minute and refill from the fridge.

faq.q: How many people does it serve?
faq.a: 6 to 8 people as an appetizer, on a 16–20 inch board.
